card.name: Partway through premedication and similar words
card.fires_on: The middle of split-up medical words such as pre-med-ication, Prem-ed-icate, hyperbil-ir-ubinemia, and local an-esthetic. It also fires on a few short linking words in oncology dosing text.

modes.label: Premedication words
modes.description: The piece inside pre-medication or premedicate, right before the word is finished.

modes.label: Other long clinical words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long lab or drug term, such as bilirubinemia or anesthetic.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: A short word like prior, the, or peripheral that comes before a clinical term in oncology label text.
modes.example: evaluated by echocardiogram or MUGA<< prior>> to administration of the initial dose

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long medical words, mostly premedication, while the word is still being completed.
